defect.cause: Unwrapped native confirm returns in eleven mutating UI paths omit markNativeDialogReturn; Chrome may resume before another tab's shared logout reaches localStorage and send protected RPC with revoked login
defect.repro: Real two-tab Chrome fingerprint non-workday photo save; sibling clear-all and key-delete both send old-token save_my_fingerprint_photo RPC
defect.fix: Call markNativeDialogReturn immediately after each of 11 native mutation confirms, enabling the existing 180ms task settlement and pre-RPC ownership revalidation

harness_note: An intermediate full test run failed only because its expected SHA/byte assertion still pointed at the previous candidate. Updated test fixture then three final full suites passed; not counted as product defect.
limitations: Actual Chrome headless with desktop/mobile emulation; RPCs stubbed, not live Supabase
Production SQL/RLS and authenticated backend multiuser untested
iOS Safari and persisted BFCache untested
chat_length_controls: GitHub holds full sources/tests/logs; conversation receives concise KST summaries. Test depth/time/repetition unchanged.
